title: ICC-ES ESR-1233: STO StoGuard air and water-resistive barrier coatings and StoEnergy Guard (coating with continuous insulation)
jurisdiction: United States (ICC-ES evaluation report under IBC/IRC); NON-ALBERTA COMPARATIVE ONLY: cannot establish Alberta performance, acceptance or equivalence; no Canadian or Alberta approval is claimed or implied
code_edition: 2024 and 2021 IBC, IRC and IECC (report §1.1, p1); CALGreen 2022, IgCC, ASHRAE 189.1 and ICC 700 (§1.2, p1)
document_date: Reissued February 2026; subject to renewal February 2027 (p1)

facts.text: Report holder STO CORP.; subject is the StoGuard air barrier and water-resistive barrier system and StoEnergy Guard.
Installation must comply with the report, the manufacturer's published instructions and the applicable code; the report governs a conflict.
EIFS applications need special inspection per IBC §1705.15.1; other applications need no jobsite special inspection where a manufacturer-trained installer provides a certificate of installation.
Systems are limited to walls and must be covered with an exterior wall finish that complies with the code or a current evaluation report.
StoEnergy Guard foam must be installed per ICC-ES ESR-2142 or ESR-4755.
Exterior-wall use in Types I-IV: assemblies in Tables 1 and 2 comply with NFPA 285 and IBC §2603.5 when installed per the report.
Evidence listed: AC212 (February 2015, editorially revised June 2024) for water-resistive coatings; NFPA 285 test and analysis.

limitations: Non-Alberta comparative attachment; the report does not reference NBC(AE) 2023 and is not evidence of Alberta or Canadian acceptance.
